stage: after checkpoint selection and before national prediction freezing, intervention freezing, or target-discharge opening
trigger: The stock NeuralHydrology tester evaluates one gauge at a time and recomputes a 365-day sequence for every predicted day. The MC-LSTM benchmark showed that this execution schedule would require approximately 22 hours per seed on CPU.
change: Use the same NeuralHydrology Config, GenericDataset, collate function, model class, checkpoint, pre-model hook, target subsetting, and framework scaler while batching samples across groups of target gauges on Apple MPS.
validation: Before each national archive is written, two blinded gauges are evaluated three ways. The cross-gauge CPU implementation must reproduce the unmodified gauge-wise stock CPU evaluator within 0.000002 absolute and relative tolerance. Accelerator arithmetic must remain within 0.02 mm/day maximum absolute difference, 0.001 mm/day median absolute difference, and 1% maximum relative difference.
mclstm_batch_semantics: NeuralHydrology 1.13.0 normalizes MC-LSTM state by one L1 norm over the complete evaluator batch. The grouped evaluator therefore preserves each gauge's stock 256-sample microbatch as an independent norm group; it does not mix gauge states.
failure_rule: No national prediction archive is written if parity fails.
effect_on_scientific_design: none; only the inference execution schedule and device differ
